rows.description: Monobloc rail wheel; 8 per four-axle coach
rows.datums: Wheel bore axis A; machined back rim face B
rows.dimensions: New/worn tread diameter; flange height/thickness/angle and root; tread/profile coordinates; rim width; hub bore/length/OD; web contour and fillets; back-face and tread runout
rows.current_values: 500 and 600 mm diameters are prior brake calculation probes only; every cutting dimension held
rows.release_evidence: Rail/turnout profile match + wheel contact, web/hub fatigue and thermal analysis; forging drawing/stock allowance; approved material/class.

rows.datums: Common journal axis A; axial locating shoulder B
rows.dimensions: Journal/wheel/disc seat diameters and lengths; bearing spacing; overall length; shoulder positions; radii/reliefs/chamfers; bore if any; end retention; all finishes/coaxiality
rows.release_evidence: Bearing selection; full axle beam/FEA load model; rotating bending/fretting fatigue; brake torque and side loads; material and NDT acceptance.

rows.datums: Wheel rotation A; disc mounting face B; pilot C
rows.dimensions: Integral hub face/pilot/bolt circle; fastener size/count, thread or through-hole fit; disc offset; backface access; runout; bolt preload
rows.current_values: ORX capability verified; pattern and thickness held
rows.release_evidence: Selected disc/caliper envelope, max torque including spring and combined faults, hub fatigue, joint slip/bearing/bolt and thermal growth checks.

rows.description: Axle-mounted disc seat/carrier; alternate to H-01A
rows.datums: Axle rotation A; axial seat location B
rows.dimensions: Seat diameter/length; hub bore, interference, shoulder/retention; rotor attachment; removal tooling
rows.current_values: Separate design alternative; not both selected
rows.release_evidence: Manufacturer-supported carrier interface, axle stress concentration/fretting, slip and axial retention at hot/cold limits.

rows.datums: Common journal axis A; wheelset mid-plane B
rows.dimensions: Wheel back-to-back; wheel gauge at profile datum; matched rolling diameters; bearing and disc locations; radial/axial runout; final mass
rows.current_values: 36 in track gauge is retained, not a wheelset machining dimension
rows.release_evidence: Track designer and vehicle engineer release matched profile/back-to-back tolerances; recorded assembly and acceptance measurement.

rows.description: Inspection gauges and wheelset handling fixtures
rows.dimensions: Profile template coordinates; back-to-back gauge; runout support locations; axle protection; press tooling contact faces
rows.current_values: Fixture production starts only after part datums released
rows.release_evidence: Wheel shop tooling review; instrument calibration, safe support and handling capacity.
